title: 40% off 1kg Bag of Any Coffee Blend (from $39.99/KG) + Free Express Shipping @ Airjo Coffee Roasters
body:
Deal: 40% off 1kg Bag of Any Coffee Blend (from $39.99/KG) + Free Express Shipping @ Airjo Coffee Roasters

[SoTightEcoLPI] Oh great, they've just up the RRP for 40% off?
[HomeAlone] I purchased 1kg bags of Enterprise 2-3 months back at 40% off and it came to $34.99 each.
Now with 40% off it's $39.99
~14% price increase.
[Jolakot] All coffee beans have gone up massively, getting single origin for under $40/kg is a good deal now, I remember getting it for $25/kg like 12 months ago.
[jv] All coffee beans have gone up massively
So switch to tea .
[tsugnev] What's recommended for cold brews? I'm just using my Hario 1L jug
[Murpha] Considering the deal includes free express shipping, I don't find it too bad for the quantity and quality. Still enjoying my Enterprise and Decaf beans from the last deal!
[Bluemetal] I’ve been a Sumatra drinker the whole time. Wondering about other blends, but not stronger, any recommendations?
Generally have lattes or cappuccinos
[choory] Recently, I only buy medium roasting 1kg coffee bean from Aldi monthly. Only $17.99, good enough for iced cafe latte. Thanks to my dull tongue…
